q: The Fisher information metric on a statistical manifold {p_θ} is defined as:
exp: The Fisher metric g_ij = E_θ[∂ᵢlog p_θ ∂ⱼlog p_θ] (also = -E[∂ᵢ∂ⱼlog p_θ]) gives the Riemannian structure on the statistical manifold. It is also the Hessian of the KL divergence: D_KL(p_θ||p_{θ+dθ}) ≈ (1/2)∑g_ij dθᵢdθⱼ.
